title: Memory feature withdrawal during asynchronous reads and recall still discloses completed data to the model
cause: Consumers captured offered scopes before asynchronous storage or model work. Completed data reused that captured set, and disabling recall did not cancel its pending model admission.
implementation: Catalog rows are filtered against current exact scopes; recall rechecks current switches and scopes after metadata/preparation and before reads/injection. Live memory setting commits abort active recall controllers. Main memory read/search tools recheck every requested scope after storage completion while owner-facing reads remain available.

verification.unitCalculation: 281 cases in complete memory suite plus one later implicit multi-scope search case. The other28 cases repeated with that file and runtime-version repetitions are not additional unique cases.
verification.native: Actual shipped dsh headless profile in source and built modes uses file settings, JSON storage, a local model adapter, the real Agent loop and memory tools. Nine unchanged cases fail with complete private old consumer packages: pending catalog rows, personal/workspace/project read/search bodies and both recall completion paths cross withdrawal. Current packages pass. Turning recall alone off still permits ordinary memory tools; disabling memory refuses them. Member reads retain the original body.
verification.admission: Real LlmRuntime with a held late budget grant observes selector cancellation before disposal, invokes no model adapter and releases the late lease once. Metadata, prepared-call and full-entry completion checks also have focused cases.
verification.normalCases: Five pre-existing recorded/Loader memory scenarios, including canonical catalog transcript, disabled/enabled owner access and recall addresses, pass unchanged. New non-recorded CLI observations use the owner-local test:expected lane.
verification.types: Edited consumer specs and actual CLI expected test have zero own or transitive diagnostics with explicit referenced package faces and the existing resource-budget Context declaration. No new manifest or lock change is required.
verification.build: Normal scoped TypeScript compile and tsdown builds pass for memory-context and tool-memory; both runtime entries and matching type-plane JS/declarations are captured.
verification.documentation: All20 doc-quick checks, export JSDoc, six bilingual pairs and127-file catalog freshness pass. Full doc-sync and whole-repository checks are not claimed.
